description: RFC 8621 §2.3 defines two additional request arguments for Mailbox/query: sortAsTree (sort results as a tree ordered by parentId hierarchy) and filterAsTree (exclude mailboxes whose ancestors do not match the filter). The handler at mailbox.rs reads neither argument. A client sending sortAsTree=true or filterAsTree=true gets silently wrong results: results are always sorted by id string and no ancestor filtering is applied. There is no defined error code for unimplemented query arguments, so the server cannot signal this limitation.
title: Mailbox/query: sortAsTree and filterAsTree silently ignored
